text.label: Text: I opened a restaurant in 1986 and I have
text.value: I opened a restaurant in 1986 and I have owned a business ever since. I was always the one who picked the tools, connected them and made them work. Big companies have a name for that job. A CTO is a Chief Technology Officer, the person who decides what software a company runs and makes all of it work together. They pay one north of $200,000.00 a year. Fractional means part-time and shared, so a coach, author or influencer with a small team can finally have one.

text.label: Text: A restaurant. A mortgage company. A roof
text.value: A restaurant. A mortgage company. A roofing company. A trucking company I ran for twenty years. And now this one, a technology company installing

text.label: Text: AI operating systems and processes.
text.value: AI employees, and the systems that run them.

text.label: Text: Good help was hard to find and harder to
text.value: Good help was hard to find and harder to keep, so in the first four I did it all myself: the work, the books, the follow-up, the ads, and yes, I was the computer guy too. Every time a better tool showed up, I was the one who learned it, set it up and made it earn its keep.

text.label: Text: So I have sat in your chair. I know what
text.value: So I have sat in your chair. I know what it feels like to be great at the work and still buried under every message, every sale and every follow-up. I have lived it four times. Steven James Consulting does not run that way. It has a team behind the work, and the systems that finally make a team worth having. That is the difference between then and now, and it is why I can say this plainly: I package your knowledge and build it all for you.

text.label: Heading: When somebody asks what I do for a living, I finally have th
text.value: When somebody asks what I do for a living, I finally have the answer.

text.label: Text: It took me a while.
text.value: It took me a while.

text.label: Text: It is hard to see yourself clearly. For years I could tell y
text.value: It is hard to see yourself clearly. For years I could tell you everything my team and I build and still not tell you what I am. I only just worked it out. I am a modern day talent agent. Self-proclaimed, and I am fine with that. Steven James Consulting is a modern day talent agency. That is the whole company, and every page on this website is one part of it.

text.label: Text: Why it is new.
text.value: Why it is new.

text.label: Text: This job could not exist before. If you had something worth
text.value: This job could not exist before. If you had something worth hearing, you needed radio or television to be heard. Both cost money, and there was somebody standing at the door deciding who got in. Plenty of talented people never got into that space at all. Then social media came along, and it costs you nothing. A podcast is practically free when somebody else handles the technical side. The door is open now. Anybody can be seen.

text.label: Text: What is still missing.
text.value: What is still missing.

text.label: Text: Being seen and being paid are two different things. Plenty o
text.value: Being seen and being paid are two different things. Plenty of people have the audience now and still have nothing to sell it, or no way to sell it without answering every message themselves. What they need is what talent has always needed: somebody behind them who knows how to turn being seen into being paid. That is the job. It is the one my team and I do.

text.label: Text: Self-promotion.
text.value: Self-promotion.

text.label: Text: Here is the plain word for it. You have to do self-promotion
text.value: Here is the plain word for it. You have to do self-promotion to make your business work. That is true whatever you do for a living, and it is even more true when the thing you sell is what you know. Nobody ever showed most people how. So that is the first thing a talent agent does. I show you how to promote yourself on the platforms that cost nothing, and my team does the heavy lifting behind you.

text.label: Text: Then we package it.
text.value: Then we package it.

text.label: Text: Next we take what you know and package it into something a p
text.value: Next we take what you know and package it into something a person can buy, starting with your own e-book with your name on the cover. Then we show you how to sell it with a modern website and a sales system behind it. That sales system has a name. It is the Revenue Engine, six business systems working as one, with AI employees doing the work day and night. Self-promotion brings the attention. The package gives people something to buy. The Revenue Engine makes the sale.

text.label: Text: What I see out there.
text.value: What I see out there.

text.label: Text: Every page on this website and every system we build is ther
text.value: Every page on this website and every system we build is there to make that world class. And I will say this plainly. I do not see anybody else offering it. I see people who will build you a website and people who will edit your videos. I do not see anyone who gets behind one person, does all of it for them, and stays. You bring what you know. We get behind it.

text.label: Text: The reps come first.
text.value: The reps come first.

text.label: Text: A talent agent is only as good as the talent. I spent forty
text.value: A talent agent is only as good as the talent. I spent forty years putting in my own reps across five businesses, and I look for the same thing in the people we take on. Nobody listens to somebody who has not done the work. If you have put in your ten thousand hours and you know your subject cold, you have something worth promoting. My job is to make sure it gets seen and gets paid.

text.label: Text: What changed
text.value: What changed

text.label: Heading: Every decade handed me a slightly better set…
text.value: Every decade handed me a slightly better set of software tools. None of them did the work. YET...

text.label: Text: Phone and fax. The first websites. Email
text.value: Phone and fax. The first websites. Email. Customer-list software. Social media. I used each one as it arrived, and each one helped a little. But not one of them ever did the actual work. They sat there and waited for a person to push the button. They were tools, and I was still the one holding them.

text.label: Text: That changed for good in 2024.
text.value: That changed for good in 2024.

text.label: Text: I could finally hire the employee I had
text.value: I could finally hire the employee I had been looking for my whole career: an AI employee. For the first time, the tool does the work. It takes the training. It does not quit. It does not call in sick or take days off. It answers every message and every inquiry the second it comes in, follows up, books the call, and circles back on the cold ones. It does the job the same way every time, and I can see everything it does. That is what changed the math. You now have AI employees where you used to need human employees. They take the grinding, repetitive work that burned out every good person I ever hired, so a small team of people worth having can do what used to take a department. That is how this company runs, and it is what I build for you.

text.label: Text: Why it matters to you
text.value: Why it matters to you

text.label: Heading: Five businesses taught me the same lesson five times. You on

text.label: Text: A fair question.
text.value: A fair question.

text.label: Text: You teach, you write or you have built an audience. Why woul
text.value: You teach, you write or you have built an audience. Why would a man who ran a restaurant and a trucking company matter to you? Because selling what you know is a business like any other. Somebody hears about you. They get curious. They ask a question and wait for an answer. They decide whether they trust you. Then they pay you or they walk away. I have watched that same sequence in five different industries. The product changes. The sequence never does.

text.label: Text: The restaurant.
text.value: The restaurant.

text.label: Text: A restaurant teaches you that people judge you on whether it
text.value: A restaurant teaches you that people judge you on whether it is the same every time. A great night followed by a sloppy one loses the customer. That only happens with a system, because no person is at their best every shift. For you, it means the follower who writes to you at midnight gets the same good answer as the one who writes at noon. Your AI employee gives the answer you would give, the way you would give it, every single time.

text.label: Text: The mortgage company.
text.value: The mortgage company.

text.label: Text: Mortgages taught me speed and follow-up. The person asking a
text.value: Mortgages taught me speed and follow-up. The person asking a question today is interested today. Wait until tomorrow and they have moved on or found somebody else. And almost nobody says yes in the first conversation. They need to hear from you again and again. It takes seven to ten times before most people trust you enough to pay. For you, that is the system that answers every comment, message and form in seconds, and then keeps following up long after a person would have given up.

text.label: Text: The roofing company.
text.value: The roofing company.

text.label: Text: Nobody hires a roofer without asking who else has used him.
text.value: Nobody hires a roofer without asking who else has used him. People want to see that somebody like them already took the chance and came out happy. It is the same when a stranger is deciding whether to buy your program or your book. For you, that is the system that asks every client, student and reader for a testimonial, every time, without anybody on your team having to remember. The proof piles up on your website and does the convincing for you.

text.label: Text: The trucking company.
text.value: The trucking company.

text.label: Text: Twenty years in trucking taught me two things. First, know y
text.value: Twenty years in trucking taught me two things. First, know your numbers, because every mile costs something and guessing is how you go broke. Second, the easiest sale you will ever make is to somebody who already bought from you once. For you, that is the system that goes back to everyone who ever followed you, asked a question or bought something, and offers them the next thing you sell. Most people with an audience never go back. That is where the easiest money is sitting.

text.label: Text: What that means for you.
text.value: What that means for you.

text.label: Text: Every part of what my team and I build comes from a lesson I
text.value: Every part of what my team and I build comes from a lesson I already paid for, with my own money and my own payroll. In four businesses I learned what has to happen between a stranger noticing you and a customer paying you. In the fifth I finally have AI employees who can do all of it, day and night, at a size no small team could manage by hand. You get the forty years without spending forty years.

If having your own podcast and your own product scares you, we are not the right fit. If it sounds like what you have been missing, we should talk.

props.text: Out of forty years and five businesses, this is the part I like best. Tying the systems together. Connecting the dots so what you teach runs as one machine instead of six disconnected ones.

Most people who built an audience find this side of it boring: the tracking, the numbers, the KPIs, which is just the handful of figures that tell you whether the thing is actually working. I have never found it boring. If you cannot see those numbers, you do not know what is going on inside what you have built. You are guessing.
So when someone tells me they want their systems connected and their numbers tracked, that is a good day for me. Those are my favorite people to work with.

And if it has never been your side of things, it needs to become your side. That is the line between owning a business and owning a job. An owner knows what a sale cost, which video or system produced it, and what that buyer was worth. Everybody else finds out how the year went when the accountant tells them.
I say that plainly because it is what I believe, and because it is the whole reason this company exists. If you cannot see your own numbers, you cannot improve anything I build for you.
